properties.description: The changelog check, on the real files in CI's workspace suite: every deprecation::REGISTRY entry is named (each name in backticks) under ### Deprecated with a What to do line, in a changelog.d fragment until its release is cut, then in that release's CHANGELOG.md section. Held to each way it fails with test-only entries: no fragment, the wrong heading, no What to do line, a partial name, a release already cut that never announced it, and a version that is not one.
properties.name: tests/every_deprecation_is_announced_in_the_changelog.rs
